quotes.author: Victoria Scotti
quotes.text: We had a group of 11 in this boat, and had an awesome time with Captain Stephen. He brought his camera aboard and took some great pics of the group, and was super accommodating all the way through. The boat is rad- our group fit perfectly on it (not too crowded), and we had fun eating lunch, sailing and swimming in the water. We'll definitely be back!

quotes.author: Ryan Howard
quotes.text: My friends and I had a great time this Memorial Day Weekend '24 aboard The Chief! It was easy to book, communication was great, the boat is awesome and our captain (Richard) was the best! Will definitely book again!

My husband and I were lucky enough to sail with Charters 2000 just this month. The boat was well maintained and docked in a very nice part of the Marina. We had a nice tour of the Harbor on our way out to sail. We saw sea lions, lots of seabirds and even a dolphin.....right in the harbor!!!!

quotes.author: Sabrina
quotes.text: It was great to bring our own food and drinks to the boat. I recommend it, we had an awesome time!
